channel.title: BTC Media Labs — news
channel.description: Updates from BTC Media Labs: products, research and company news.

item.title: Provisional patent filed for calibrated abstention
item.description: We filed a provisional patent application covering our method for on-device systems that recognise when they are unsure and abstain rather than guess. It is the technical core of our research programme.

item.title: EverHeard 1.0 submitted to Apple
item.description: Version 1.0 of EverHeard for iPhone, iPad and Mac went to the App Store for review, after an extended TestFlight beta.

item.title: BTC Media Labs LLC formed in New York
item.description: The studio was incorporated as BTC Media Labs LLC, giving the products a single home after operating inside our advisory practice since 2023.
